decisions.decision: Use the eight-phase H3.0 through H3.7 programme.
Hero V2 is the sacred ancestor, live fallback and rollback target.
Preserve gradient-cut wave lineage and luminous multi-colour play.
The eventual Sacred Hero may change only after direct complete V2 versus V3 Founder comparison.
Current copy and CTA visual design may be replaced; production wording remains governed.
Magenta, turquoise and gold are core Champagne brand colours.
Deep Persian velvet blue and Porcelain are important wider luxury surfaces, not compulsory dominant Hero art direction.
Champagne should feel luminous, fluid, rich and elegant.
St Mary's House influence is supporting and selective, not primary.
Over-architectural, SaaS-like, overly dark and generic-luxury drift.
Detached thick glossy CGI ribbon or toothpaste-like replacement concepts.
Diagnose the visible current motion seam independently before repair.
Make the static composition exceptional before scored motion convergence.
First family tranche proves approximately four materially different grammars before expansion.
The tenant engine must prove organic botanical and precise geometric tenants without Champagne brand leakage.
Do not hard-code Champagne Brand DNA into the tenant-neutral renderer.
No production replacement, Ready, merge, deployment, cutover or production binding is authorised.
